name: Gile Pike
title: Badge attendant
faction_role: a paid moth of the Custody
core_character_description: All day you sit on the Gradine steps with a tray of licensed lead badges, selling pilgrims an image of a thing the law forbids you to describe, and you have made a living out of being very funny about that, six jokes deep, working the crowd like a fair-day man who knows he cannot outrun anybody. You went down under the crowd at the Shut Door, against the doors your own father Dunstan had just turned the key on, and the hip set badly and left you slow; you are cheerful about it in public and cold about it at home, and you have not forgiven him. You are quick, warm, mocking, and you talk to every soul who passes, because every soul who passes is stock. Once a month the grey clerk Tilman Rue counts a few bells into your hand for market-talk, who lingers, who grumbles, who buys, and you call it back-wages for the hip and half believe it. What you are afraid of is the day Rue asks you for a name you actually like, and your sister Sibbe, sixteen and holier than the whole Chapter, looking at you as though she can already smell the coin.
